features.label: Undulating color areas
features.explanation: Simplify existing forms into rolling overlapping arcs and bands of color
features.evidence: Ridgelines, valleys and clouds are simplified into overlapping arcs and bands of color, repeated at uneven intervals. The contours and brushwork on slopes follow the turns of the terrain together, creating an undulating, flowing rhythm.
features.zh: 将现有形体概括为起伏、交叠的弧形与带状色面
features.en: Simplify existing forms into rolling overlapping arcs and bands of color

features.label: Decorative contours
features.explanation: Keep contours clear with repeated but unevenly spaced rhythms
features.evidence: Birch trunks and fine branches provide pale, curved vertical lines; dark conifers form compact silhouettes, and warm canopies are organized with simplified contours. These forms interweave in the autumn woodland examples, both framing the view and directing the eye into the valley.
features.zh: 保持轮廓清楚，以重复但不等距的节奏组织边线
features.en: Keep contours clear with repeated but unevenly spaced rhythms

features.label: Gold and orange against cool teal
features.explanation: Contrast golden yellow and orange-ochre lights with deep teal and blue-green shadows
features.evidence: Golden yellow, orange-red and russet concentrate on sunlit slopes and foliage; deep teal, blue-green and cool blue organize woodland interiors, shaded planes and the distance. Light and shade on each hill are clearly divided, while dark colors still support the vivid warm areas.
features.zh: 用金黄、橙赭受光色对照深青、蓝绿阴影
features.en: Contrast golden yellow and orange-ochre lights with deep teal and blue-green shadows

features.label: Sunlight in distinct planes
features.explanation: Show daylight through clear divisions between light and shade
features.evidence: Rocks, trunks and strong shadows remain in the foreground, while cooler, lighter blue-greens occupy the distance; patches of light on the slopes suggest sunlight. Overlap, color temperature and value work together to establish spatial layers, while individual forms retain a decorative character.
features.zh: 以清楚的受光与背光分区表现日光
features.en: Show daylight through clear divisions between light and shade

features.label: Warm–cool depth
features.explanation: Keep original overlaps and use cooler, lighter distance to build depth
features.evidence: Rocks, trunks and strong shadows remain in the foreground, while cooler, lighter blue-greens occupy the distance; patches of light on the slopes suggest sunlight. Overlap, color temperature and value work together to establish spatial layers, while individual forms retain a decorative character.
features.zh: 保留原有遮挡，以较冷较浅的远景建立深度
features.en: Keep original overlaps and use cooler, lighter distance to build depth

features.label: Directional brushwork
features.explanation: Model surfaces with short strokes, bands and dabs that follow the direction of existing forms
features.evidence: Major forms are first organized as relatively continuous color areas, then details are shaped with short strokes, bands, dabs and irregular patches of broken color. Directional brushwork describes hills, cloud bands and ground, while leaves are often indicated with separate small patches of bright color.
features.zh: 用短笔、条带和点触顺着原有形体方向塑造表面
features.en: Model surfaces with short strokes, bands and dabs that follow the direction of existing forms

features.label: Bright rhythm
features.explanation: Create a bright, lively and rhythmic visual impression
features.evidence: Autumn (1940) emphasizes broad hills and clouds; October Gold (1922) frames a dark valley with birches and dense golden foliage; Festive Autumn (1921) creates a bright foreground from trees, traces of logging, rocks and scattered patches of light. The three share rhythms of color and form, while varying in brushstroke density.
features.zh: 营造明朗、蓬勃而有节奏的观看感受
features.en: Create a bright, lively and rhythmic visual impression

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
